items.title: Barney Bigard Interview, Early 1970s
items.q: I made some with Freddie Slight

ctx.x: Do you have any idea how many records you may have recorded over the years? Oh, not the faintest idea.

You lost count after 5,000 I bet. Oh, easy. I made them all with Duke, I made some of my own, I made some with Freddie Slight, and I made a lot of them with Louie. And I made a lot of different groups, you know, like on the side, what do you call a sideline, you know, one of those deals. And made a lot of studio recordings.

So it's pretty high. You know, we've had a number of people on the show, and we've talked to them about jazz, or swing, or big bands, or whatever you want to call it. And it would seem to me that you would be the man that would know the origin of such terms as jazz. Because you were born originally down there in the Crescent City itself, weren't you?
